stem: What is the most likely reason that states built tollgates and tollhouses along the National Road in the 1830s?

options.label: A
options.text: To collect money to pay for road maintenance

options.label: B
options.text: To prevent the road from being too crowded

options.label: C
options.text: To keep construction crews busy after the main road had been created

options.label: D
options.text: To pay the federal government for the use of the road
